SEALCOATING

Sealcoating is an important part of protecting and maintaining your asphalt. It helps protect the surface from damaging UV rays, water penetration, oxidation, oil and other automotive fluids, while helping slow deterioration and extend the life of the pavement. Our top-quality commercial-grade sealcoat also restores a clean, dark appearance to your asphalt. All sealcoating applications are done by hand using a brush or squeegee — never sprayed — for a long-lasting, durable finish.

⌁

CRACK FILLING

Crack filling helps prevent water from penetrating the pavement, reduces further cracking, and helps extend the life of your asphalt. We only use top-grade hot-pour crack-filling material, a durable, long-lasting option designed to properly seal cracks and help protect your asphalt from water intrusion and further damage. We take the time to properly clean and prepare cracks before filling them.

▦

RESIDENTIAL & COMMERCIAL

We proudly serve both residential and commercial customers with reliable, high-quality asphalt maintenance solutions. Residential driveways are sealcoated by hand using a brush or squeegee for a consistent, durable finish. For larger commercial properties, sealcoat may be professionally spray-applied when appropriate, depending on the size of the lot and project requirements. Every property is different, so the application method and project approach are selected based on pavement condition, property size, traffic needs, and the time available to complete the work.

ASPHALT MAINTENANCE

WHEN SHOULD ASPHALT BE SEALCOATED?

Regular sealcoating helps protect asphalt before serious deterioration begins. Most asphalt surfaces benefit from sealcoating once the pavement has properly cured and then periodically as the protective surface wears down. Keeping up with routine maintenance can help prevent costly repairs and extend the life of your driveway or parking lot.

Never had any maintenance done to your driveway? It’s not too late. Old or new, all asphalt can benefit from sealcoating and crack filling. Sealcoating and crack filling can also be done to help extend the lifespan of your driveway in its current condition and help avoid the cost of having your driveway repaved. Not only are you helping to extend the life of your driveway, but you’re also giving it that fresh, deep black look while enhancing your property’s curb appeal.

ATTENTION TO DETAIL

We take pride in doing the job right from start to finish. Every driveway is carefully prepared and sealed with close attention to detail, leaving you with a clean, professional-looking finish.

THOROUGH PREPARATION

A quality sealcoat job starts with proper preparation. Dirt, loose material, vegetation, oil spots, and problem areas should be addressed before sealer is applied so the coating can bond properly and perform as intended. We take the time to clean the pavement, create clean edges, and properly prepare the surface before application.
